convention_note: MANDATORY FINAL ARTIFACT CONVENTION: source_sha=HEAD before sprint, final_commit_sha=last commit, artifact_build_head_sha=git rev-parse HEAD before ZIP, both equal. No post_zip_commit_sha. No bundle_manifest_commit_sha. No TBD. No placeholder SHA. ZIP built last.
artifact_loop_resolution: Single-commit approach: Commit_1 contains all files. SHA-dependent fields updated on disk after Commit_1 (uncommitted). ZIP built from disk at HEAD=Commit_1. artifact_build_head_sha = final_commit_sha = Commit_1 SHA. No loop possible.
